_about: Suno style prompts per genre key (see tools/suno_generate.py). Describe the sound; Suno rejects artist names. modifiers are the associations we want the room to feel (Approach 1). bpm is a range; each generation picks one and records it.

bossa_house.label: Bossa Nova
bossa_house.prompt: classic 60s bossa nova, chill, cosy cafe
bossa_house.notes: Tried 30 Sep + 5 Oct: good. Tempo climbs through the morning, 120 at 6am to 140 by noon (128 felt right mid-morning); also plays on cloudy mornings. No flute: the weirder takes added one and it didn't fit the chill cafe.

jazzhop.label: Jazz-hop
jazzhop.prompt: upbeat japanese jazz-hop, chill, cosy cafe
jazzhop.notes: Tried 30 Sep: 82 bpm was too slow; upbeat at ~92 is right.

lofi_indie.label: Ghibli Lofi
lofi_indie.prompt: upbeat ghibli lofi, bouncy beats, cool, cosy cafe
lofi_indie.notes: Tried 30 Sep: no rap / no voices; needs to be more upbeat for the busy afternoon. 98 bpm tech house was too fast; four-on-the-floor kicks feel anxious.

whimsy_fantasy.label: Whimsy Fantasy
whimsy_fantasy.prompt: melancholic celtic fantasy, cello and harp, slow and nostalgic, quiet journey, cosy cafe
whimsy_fantasy.notes: Tried 5 Oct: whimsy and bright celtic-orchestral prompts missed (too bright, not mellow). Inspired by the Frieren soundtrack: cello, harp, fantasy folk instruments, nostalgic. Variants D (celtic) and F (elven folk, dulcimer) approved; flute is fine here. Made with Weirdness 55 / Style Influence 70 / Variety High.
prompts: melancholic celtic fantasy, cello and harp, slow and nostalgic, quiet journey, cosy cafe
gentle elven folk lament, harp, cello, hammered dulcimer, misty and bittersweet, cosy cafe

dark_academia.label: Dark Academia
dark_academia.prompt: dark academia piano, chill, cosy cafe

electronic_lofi.label: Electronic Lofi
electronic_lofi.prompt: electronic soul deep house, steady deep-house pulse, analog synth chorus drifting softly through warm tape haze, mellow electric bass under a hypnotic lo-fi drum machine and soft, nostalgic synth layers
electronic_lofi.notes: 6 Oct: liked ('Cloudy Afternoon Soul'). Made by hand around 110 bpm with only 'beat drop' excluded. Plays 30% of new music on clear afternoons (Ghibli Lofi 50%, Whimsy Fantasy 20%). The two prompts rotate.
prompts: electronic soul deep house, steady deep-house pulse, analog synth chorus drifting softly through warm tape haze, mellow electric bass under a hypnotic lo-fi drum machine and soft, nostalgic synth layers
ghibli lofi touch, late-night organic deep house beats, synthwave soul, minor key, moody analog synths, mellow electric bass, hypnotic lofi drum machine beat, nostalgic chillwave atmosphere

_shared: Keep prompts short: the style, then chill/cosy cafe; the generator adds a BPM from the range and 'instrumental'. No voices, no flute, no four-on-the-floor kicks; `exclude` is sent as Suno's Exclude styles. Tried 5 Oct: Weirdness 65 / Style Influence 60 / Variety High gives clearly different takes on the same prompt. Aim for 3:30-4:30 songs (Duration: Custom in More Options) to get more music per download: Premier allows 60 downloads a month. Songs already approved stay.
_duration: Default song length; a style's own duration overrides it. Longer songs in calm styles (Dark Academia, Ambient Dream) get more music per download. Suno's Custom duration goes up to 6:00.

weirdness._about: Change Weirdness on every generation, spread across the style's range, so takes differ. Below 50 is safer and more typical (suits calm styles, where surprises are jarring); above 50 adds variety and unusual instruments. Style Influence stays at the style's value.
